an8.119:1.1: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya aṭṭha dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an8.119:1.3: Ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni.
an8.119:1.4: Tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī ti evaṃsaññī hoti. 3.
an8.119:1.5: Ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni. Tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī ti evaṃsaññī hoti. 4.
an8.119:1.6: Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni. Tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī ti evaṃsaññī hoti. 5.
an8.119:1.7: Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni. Tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī ti evaṃsaññī hoti. 6.
an8.119:1.8: Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni . . . pe . . .
an8.119:1.12: Tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī ti evaṃsaññī hoti.
